fields.Name: T167 - Test Runs Search And Time Range
fields.Description: Combines client-side name search (filterBySearch) with the time-range control that re-drives the server date range (updateServiceDateRange → setDateRange) — two Runs-specific data paths distinct from the status chips.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Runs" tab. In the filter bar type a term into the "Search by test name..." box and confirm the runs table narrows to name matches (or shows the no-results empty state), then clear it with the X. Next change the time-range dropdown (Today / This Week / This Month / Last 90 Days) to a different value and confirm the table/results respond. Success is that both the search box and the time-range dropdown drive the visible runs. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the search box narrows the runs table to matching test names or shows a clear empty state
Clearing the search restores the previous run list
Changing the time-range dropdown re-queries and updates the runs table/results
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
